reason: User requires actual >=85% test accuracy and sensor-driven Apple Watch. Narrow to a supervised guided activity check suitable for foreground accelerometer capture.
target: Independent CAPTURE-24 annotation label:Willetts2018 walking=1, sit-stand=0; all other activities excluded from training/evaluation and outside deployment scope
deployment_domain: Adult user deliberately either walks normally or sits/stands still for a foreground 10-second check. Not a general activity, disease, sleep, exercise adequacy, or current health classifier.
source: Unrestricted CC BY4.0 Oxford CAPTURE-24 archive:151 people; wrist100Hz xyz in g; age and sex from actual metadata.csv

windows.sampling: Every sixth non-overlapping10s window anchored at participant record start, irrespective of label. Block mean of5source samples per target sample. Not label-balanced sampling.
windows.quality: Exactly1000 finite xyz points; monotonic timestamps with max gap<=0.025s; at least90% sample annotations share an eligible binary label; majority mapswalking orsit-stand. Other labels/unknown/transition rejected.

features: 24 orientation-independent magnitude, temporal/spectral and axis-dispersion statistics, defined in features.py; no ID/sex/age/time/annotation used as predictors
selection: Maximum validation balanced accuracy, then macroF1, then accuracy; ties nearest0.5, then logistic. Freeze selected configuration before any test evaluation. Report selected and best configuration in other family plus majority baseline on test once.
success: Actual held-out-person accuracy>=0.85; also report balancedaccuracy, macroF1, precision,recall,confusion,majority so threshold cannot conceal poorpositive performance. Failure is reported as failure.
fairness: Sex M/F and published age bins18-29/30-37/38-52/53+; share same frozen data and IDs. RF supports sample_weight. Test once for original model; subsequentFairlearn predefined finalcomparison only, mitigationtuning onvalidation.
device: CoreMotion foreground capture, timestamps verified and resampled20Hz; device/placement/filtering shift must be disclosed and tested. HealthKit readings separatelydisplayed, never substituted into acceleration model. No claims of实机success without actual installation and capture.
